بعد يومين، عشر سنوات على Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare، الجزء الذي نقل السلسلة إلى حرب في الفضاء.

صدرت يوم 4 نوفمبر 2016 على PS4 وXbox One وPC، من تطوير استوديو إنفينيتي وارد (Infinity Ward) ونشر أكتيفيجن (Activision).

وأدّى الممثل كيت هارينغتون (Kit Harington) دور الشرير الأدميرال Salen Kotch.

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #CallofDuty #InfiniteWarfare

notes.brief: on-this-day, trailer template; hook: the supercarrier over Earth, soldiers jumping out and in freefall under the headline; future city and ships under the date line; Kit Harington's close-ups under the villain line; the hero, the robot ETH.3n and the space battle under the studio line. 13.7 s.
notes.footage: story trailer (Steam 292730), 1080p 5.75 Mbps, full frame, decode clean; committed as eg-cod-iw-story-30.mp4, the 30 to 145 s stretch re-encoded at 5.6 Mbps (the whole file is 102.6 MB, over GitHub's limit); job times are source minus 30 s
notes.sound: the trailer is narrated nearly throughout; 130.4 s onward is score only for 13.7 s (render check: speech none); the track start moved from 127.8 after the check heard Harington's line
notes.arabic: grammar stage: no required edits; role word on the actor at first mention on screen and in text; DeepL forward pass agrees; back-check keeps the meaning (attribution kept)
notes.pull_forward: 2 Nov 2026 03:00Z, Mohammad: yes to pulling it forward. Three changes from the v1 the director passed on 25 Oct: no «في مثل هذا اليوم» chip (it would say the wrong day), credit-line date the release date (4 Nov 2016, v1 said 4 Nov 2026), publisher and studio in the credit (30 Oct credit rule). Ledger (formats.py check trailer 03:45Z): third trailer in a row (Bend, Sonic Generations), so v2c is a split: strip released/platforms, first line no longer repeats the date. Captions say 'بعد يومين' and Wednesday 4 Nov; platforms in English per the house rule (grammar review: PC for الحاسب).
notes.gate: gate 03:15Z: release date from Activision's own page (archived callofduty.com, 'launch on November 4th'); Steam store shows Nov 3 (time zone), publisher's date used; Wikipedia agrees; no denial or update found. Steam kept out of the source follow-up.
notes.sound_reason: v1 trailer stretch (story trailer score 130.4 s) failed the runner sound guard on 2 Nov: music 15.0% of the stretch. Our bed (retro) is the allowed sound for an anniversary piece; the preview opens with 'our bed'.
